turn1.explanation: Fires on clause- and sentence-boundary punctuation (commas, periods, semicolons) in running prose. It is strongest when the document is about ships, boats or other maritime topics.
turn1.evidence: Nearly every marked token is a comma or period, while content words barely activate (<0.2). The top examples (SeaArk boats, powerships, cruise ship casino, Swedish listed ships, flying boats, V.Ships) are maritime and reach 3.5–4.2, whereas non-maritime texts (news broadcasting, medical, legal, sci-fi review) reach only about 1.1–2.8.
turn1.missing_data: Activations on punctuation in ship-themed versus matched non-ship documents, and whether the ship context must be nearby or can be anywhere earlier in the document.
